notes: The impurity this section measures, from the [0047] lead-in at line 242 and the three ppm columns of the table at lines 247, 249 and 250. resolved false and unresolved_reference true because the printed 氰化物杂质 (cyanide impurity) names a class and the patent never says which cyanide species is present. The table figures are carried here as analytics, not in any quantity field and not on tembotrione, because they are an impurity content in ppm rather than a charge or an isolated amount. Both batches start from the same original content, recorded once. The table names no analytical method for the ppm determination, so method is other on every entry. Batch 14's reduction cell prints a bare 97 with no percent sign while batch 15 prints 94%, so unit is null on the first and % on the second; the column header carries the percent for both. Neither stated reduction figure follows from the pair of ppm values printed in its own row. Both are recorded exactly as printed and nothing is recomputed. The missing percent sign may be a loss in the table image, which has no text layer, but the vision read is what the page shows and it is not corrected here.
